body.name: \Phi_G\text{-program}
body.construction: For each \(G\in\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\), enumerate \(r\in\mathcal R_G\); on each branch introduce \(\lambda\in\prod_a\Delta(\mathcal K_{G,r,a})\), recursively evaluate every observed assignment and both interventions in \(q\), and output the finite family of polynomial programs with objective \(q_G(\lambda)\) and constraints \(P_G(\lambda)=p\).
